title: Prepared geometry descriptor
description: Model and topology identity come from the containing computation manifest. Mesh archives preserve triangulations and ordered face references in BinTools v4. Samples use DFMPS001: little-endian u32 face count, then each u32 face id and u64 row count followed by rows of 8 float64 values (xyz, normal xyz, uv) and u32 has_uv. Unknown UV is explicitly absent. No C++ object memory or BVH is serialized.
